toolsAdded.name: bash

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

Keep accepted request timestamps in a sliding window. At timestamp t, an accepted request remains active when its timestamp is >= t - window_ms; requests strictly older than that are expired.
